senses.gloss: m. (Inf. Hif. of קוּם, formed for analogy with הָפֵר q. v.) confirmation, the privilege of confirming a vow.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 10:7">Ned. X, 7</cite>; a. fr. (comment. write indiscriminately <cite ref="E00795"><he>הקם</he></cite> a. <cite ref="E00483"><he>הֵיקֵם</he></cite>, analogous to <cite ref="E00478"><he>הֵיפֵר</he></cite>).
